name: Possible Love
description: Defne, a woman in her thirties, is strong and composed, having built her career through hard work. One day, she realizes just how exhausted and isolated she has become; perhaps the time has come for love. However, two men who enter her life turn everything upside down. Caught between Kadir’s unsettling demeanor and Tolga’s games that shift the balance, Defne finds that nothing will ever be the same again.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Successful lawyer Defne Derin, while carrying the burden of her family on her shoulders, is also struggling to keep the law firm she is a partner in afloat. However, an unexpected crisis leaves her facing one of the hardest decisions of her life. Left with no choice, Defne will ask for a loan from her school friend, the heir to Bartıner Holding. With this decision, Defne finds herself at an invitation she believes she doesn't belong to. That night, it will be the stage for encounters that will affect not only her career but also her heart. Defne, whose paths cross with charismatic architect Tolga Erez and powerful businessman Kadir Emindağ, unwittingly finds herself at the center of events that will completely change her life. A single step she takes will drag her to the beginning of a journey with no return.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Defne begins to pay the price for the lie she told in a moment of panic. Now, she faces an almost impossible task before her: bringing together Kadir and Tolga, who can't even tolerate each other, on the same project. Defne, who follows Kadir all the way to his farm to convince him, encounters aspects of him she never knew. Meanwhile, Tolga is making the most of every opportunity to get closer to Defne. However, the real problem in Defne's life isn't love, but the debts piling up at her door and the law firm on the verge of falling apart. Just when she thinks everything is over, an unexpected development gives Defne hope once again. But the surprise that appears before her at the end of the night will turn not only her plans, but her heart, completely upside down.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Upon learning that Kadir has decided against divorce, Defne experiences profound disappointment and resolves to keep her distance from him. However, due to the massive project at Bartıner Holding, Defne, Kadir, and Tolga are forced to meet at the same table. As the enmity between Kadir and Tolga puts everything at risk, Levent assigns Defne the task of uncovering the truth behind this hostility. Meanwhile, an unexpected closeness that Defne will experience while trying to unravel the two men's past will once again upend everyone's balance.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Following Tolga's surprise proposal, Defne is forced to make a difficult choice between her heart and her mind. Kadir's unexpected move, succumbing to his jealousy, takes the tension between the two to an entirely different level, while Defne sets out to uncover the long-hidden secret between Kadir and Tolga. As balances shift rapidly at Bartıner Holding, truths from the past slowly begin to surface. Defne's decision and the new clues that emerge will once again reveal that nothing is as it seems, and she will learn the reason behind the enmity between Defne, Kadir, and Tolga.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The great secret spilling over from Kadir's past deeply shakes not only the Emindağ family but also the budding love between Defne and Kadir. Defne, caught between her conscience and her heart, reaches the threshold of a point of no return, while Tolga presses the button for a surprising new move that will shock everyone. Where love, secrets, and reckonings intertwine, the surprising developments will make it clear that nothing will ever be the same again.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: As Kadir draws closer to the truth with each passing day, Defne prepares to pay the heaviest price to protect the man she loves. Tolga's unexpected move upends all the established balances, while the partnership he forms with Leyla begins to threaten Defne and Kadir's happiness. Caught between her heart and her conscience, Defne reaches the brink of an irreversible decision, as a series of rapid developments drags everyone down an entirely different path. In this episode, where she faces love's greatest test, a single sentence spoken will change Defne and Kadir's story in an irrevocable way.
